name: São Gonçalo
scopeLimits: 90 valid, distinct municipal cadastral polygons verified in thirteen bounded local cells around the WUP 2025 São Gonçalo settlement locator. Complete paging, fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding checks passed. Independent GEOS audits found no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m², duplicate geometry, invalid polygons or operation errors. The exact WUP point returned no parcel; verification covers nearby mapped parcels, not exact-point or municipality-wide completeness. Native numeric id was stable during live re-reads; long-term ID permanence is undocumented.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The municipal Topovision is an official city GIS, and the municipality’s cadastral technical service procedure handles cadastral/lot-related certifications. Its public GeoServer WFS capabilities expose the city cadastral lot feature type `SaoGoncalo:lote_a_cadastro_sg`; bounded anonymous geometry queries and full adapter qualification returned parcel polygons near the ranked locator.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal Topovision GIS. Its visible/configured public layer list contains orthophoto/imagery and municipal boundary layers; it does not list the cadastral lots exposed directly by the WFS.
City Hall map and neighborhood page; supports local municipal mapping context.
Municipal form for the technical cadastre subsecretariat includes lot/legalization/parceling/certification procedures.
Public GeoServer WFS capabilities list cadastral layers including SaoGoncalo:lote_a_cadastro_sg; no account or token was used.
Layer schema exposes safe numeric `id`, polygon `geom`, and `lote`; the research request selected only `id` and geometry.
Public WFS endpoint used for bounded 13-cell geometry queries, capped pages, fresh exact-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint lookup and binding.

viewerAndServiceTrace.publicViewerBundle: Viewer HTML / bundled scripts inspected; standard startup layer list exposed orthophoto imagery and municipal boundary only.
viewerAndServiceTrace.queryMode: WFS 2.0.0; CRS:84 bbox; response in EPSG:4326; geometry-only plus id; page-size test 3; no login/token.

qualifier.qa: Independent GEOS 3.14.1 check: 90/90 polygons valid, all Polygon, non-empty; metric areas 320.9589–28692.3464 m². Full QA geometries remained in /tmp; up to three ID-plus-polygon samples are included in the companion GeoJSON.
qualifier.nativeIdField: id integer; stable across this live run and fresh-ID read, long-term permanence undocumented
qualifier.transportFeatureId: GeoServer/WFS feature.id changes for the same native id across requests; do not use as parcel identifier
qualifier.alternateCenter: No alternate center; all 13 approximately 100 m cells are centered on WUP point, whose exact probe is empty.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: The exact ranked WUP point query returned no feature. Polygons were found in adjacent cells of the bounded 13-cell grid; this establishes nearby public cadastral geometry, not coverage at the locator or citywide completeness.
verifiedParcelResponse.requestFilter: WFS 2.0.0 GetFeature; CRS:84 bbox [-43.026,-22.837,-43.025,-22.836]; propertyName=geom,id; count=1000; no credentials or tokens.
